title: iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI
claim: iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI — OfficeCLI is the first and best Office suite  purpose-built for AI agents to read, edit, and automate Word, Excel, and P
why_good: An Office suite built for agents to read/edit/automate Word, Excel and PowerPoint — the missing hands agents need to actually do office work.
value: Usage/seat pricing to teams automating documents with agents; the wedge is being the reliable Office-IO layer agents call.
risk: Microsoft is shipping Copilot deep into Office; an outside 'agent Office layer' fights the platform owner head-on.

zh.claim: iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI —— 首个为 AI agent 打造的 Office 套件:读、改、自动化 Word、Excel、PowerPoint。
zh.why_good: 为 agent 打造的 Office 套件,让它读/改/自动化 Word/Excel/PPT——agent 真正干办公活时缺的那双手。
zh.value: 按用量/席位卖给用 agent 自动化文档的团队;切口是成为 agent 调用的可靠 Office-IO 层。
zh.risk: 微软正把 Copilot 深植进 Office;外部的"agent Office 层"是在正面硬刚平台方。
